blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A former police officer will be facing an illegal possession of a firearm charge after authorities found an unlicensed gun inside his house. This was after the 40-year-old ex-cop was served a search warrant last Friday, October 16 in his house in a mountain barangay in Cebu City late Friday afternoon, Oct. 16.
